text:
Ella (Finance): Quick Q — customer ACME (private on‑prem dedicated) flagged that the GPU vendor demands a per‑GPU monthly license fee paid by the operator. They expect us to pass it through. How should we handle billing and the commit reconciliation?
Miguel (Sales): @Rita @Sam FYI. Contract language for this account said customers cover third‑party licenses unless vendor requires Redwood to manage. Need clarity.
Sam (Eng-Ops): Operational note: vendor ties license to our host image + hw fingerprint. We technically provision under Redwood-managed account, so vendor considers us the billable party. Ops lean: we pay vendor then invoice customer as pass‑through.
Rita (Legal): Prefer pass‑through with no markup where possible. But must verify reseller / reseller‑of‑record terms — some vendor agreements forbid reselling or require disclosure. Also watch tax implications.
Nadia (Customer Success): Customer wants predictable pricing. A variable monthly license line will break their budgeting. Can we fold this into their reserved commit as a fixed addendum?
Asha (Eng-Infra): We can meter per‑GPU usage with our licensing agent and export CSVs. Suggest adding a dedicated "gpu-license-pass-through" SKU so invoices clearly show it.
Ella (Finance): Any precedent?
Miguel (Sales): For client Y we absorbed vendor license for 3 months as onboarding credit. Not sustainable.
Miguel (Sales): Proposal: default = pass‑through line item, labelled "no‑markup". If customer wants predictability, offer an option to include the license in the reserved commit at a fixed blended rate.
Rita (Legal): Also check if vendor forbids itemized re‑billing of their fee. If so, we may need to include it under "infrastructure surcharge" per contract. I'll review the vendor TOS now.
infra-bot: billing-metering: Export ready — s3://billing-exports/1790123456/gpu-license-usage.csv
Asha (Eng-Infra): Example invoice snippet we can use in templates:
```json
{
  "lines": [
    {"sku":"redwood-dedicated-month","qty":1,"amount_cents":200000},
    {"sku":"gpu-license-pass-through","qty":8,"amount_cents":32000,"notes":"no-markup"}
  ]
}
```
Sam (Eng-Ops): Heads up: APAC deployments incur a vendor surcharge (regional VAT/tax handling) ~+10%. Need region code on SKU so finance can apply tax properly.
Ella (Finance): Next steps: Rita to confirm vendor TOS + any disclosure requirements; Asha to add pass‑through SKU and hook into export; Miguel to update sales proposal options (pass‑through vs included). I'll reconcile commit accounting after we have exports. 48h check-in? :thumbsup:
Rita (Legal): On it, starting contract check now.
Nadia (Customer Success): I'll prepare a short customer note template for both options (itemized pass‑through vs fixed addendum).
Ella (Finance): Thanks all — will follow up in the thread.
